description:
ProgramScreen holds 13 mutations with no onError, BodyScreen has 2, and SessionDetailScreen's set edits show a banner but offer no retry. SessionScreen and FuelPanel already carry the pattern worth copying: mutError held as {message, retry} and rendered through ErrorBanner. Adopt it in the remaining three screens so no write can fail silently.

RULES 7 makes this non-negotiable: every state-changing mutation needs a visible pending, success, or failure outcome. Silent failure on a write path the user just acted on is never acceptable.
title: Surface failure and retry on every mutation
